SELECT ID, MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME FROM T_LH_MACHINE_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG ='0' AND STATUS = '0'
AND MACHINE_NAME LIKE '%' || #{machineName} || '%'
SELECT S.EMBRYO_CODE, SUM(NVL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) + NVL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0) - NVL(S.BAD_NUM, 0)) STOCK_NUM FROM T_CX_STOCK S WHERE S.STOCK_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND S.DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY S.EMBRYO_CODE
